opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES membership required; open to researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world. Not available for undergraduate/master's degree completion or funded fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Funding for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups must be diverse with a mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing funding towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups of 8-15 individuals that analyse and synthesise existing data.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

amount.raw: £500 per year for a decade of data collection; £3,500 claimable for first five years, additional £3,500 in year six

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies taking place anywhere in the world, enabling existing short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding research informing teaching and learning practices in ecology to improve learners' experience and promote excellence in teaching.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors, immersing an ecologist in another professional world for up to 12 months.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; no restrictions on where applicants come from.
opportunities.summary: Funding for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science through outreach, public engagement and science communication activities.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £500 for events in person; a maximum of £250 for virtual conferences/courses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher; not open to postdocs, undergraduates or masters students.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member, a citizen of and based in a Global South country, travelling from and returning to that country, and must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation costs.
